name: Vitest
tagline: A Vite-powered testing framework for JavaScript and TypeScript.
hook: A validation guide to source checks, bundled output, test helpers, CI coverage, stale builds, and package exceptions.
summary: Vitest distinguishes source checks, bundled output, test helpers, and CI coverage. Command pairs and exception lists show when a successful local check has tested the wrong files or missed generated output.

techniques.title: Show the test-filter command that silently broadens a run
techniques.body: The guide pairs the pnpm invocation that loses its filter with the one that forwards it correctly. It explains the consequence so an agent can recognize an unexpectedly broad run.
techniques.quote:
# WRONG - runs ALL tests (filter is ignored):
pnpm test -- basic.test.ts -t 'expect'

# CORRECT - runs only matching tests:
pnpm test basic.test.ts -t 'expect'

techniques.title: Separate source checking from the output tests execute
techniques.body: Typechecking reads TypeScript source while tests resolve workspace exports into dist. The mocker package is singled out because rebuilding Vitest does not inline its changes.
techniques.quote: Tests execute built output: test suites resolve `vitest` through workspace symlinks whose package exports point at `dist/`, while `pnpm typecheck` resolves TypeScript source. A passing typecheck never proves `dist` is fresh; rebuild before re-running tests.

techniques.title: State the holes in the root typecheck
techniques.body: The file lists the excluded test and documentation directories. It also supplies a separate command for Vue UI client changes, making the coverage boundary part of the workflow.
techniques.quote: Root typecheck does not cover the UI client Vue code; when changing `packages/ui/client`, also run `pnpm -C packages/ui typecheck:client`

techniques.title: Name generated files even when the file has no banner
techniques.body: CLI option changes require regenerating the documentation table. The guide also explains that CI rebuilds and checks the diff, so reverting generated output does not make a change complete.
techniques.quote: `docs/guide/cli-generated.md` is generated from `packages/vitest/src/node/cli/cli-config.ts` (it carries no banner saying so)

techniques.title: Make external contribution limits explicit
techniques.body: Opening issues, PRs, or comments requires human review. Contributors without write access are limited to one PR and are explicitly prohibited from using drafts to bypass that boundary.
techniques.quote: This repository has a limit of 1 PR if you don't have write access. DO NOT try to bypass it by creating draft PRs.

steal: Explain when source checks and tests consume different artifacts.
Pair misleading command syntax with a corrected invocation.
List the important exclusions from default verification.
Name unmarked generated files and the commands that produce them.
outline: If you are an AI agent
